scope: Crustal thickness inversions with laterally variable crust density (shell + relief decomposition, regularised fixed-point inversion), anchored to 39 km at InSight. Densities are declared scenarios; no scenario is a fitted best model.

validation_equal_2900.note: The archive uses the depth-dependent Khan2022 mantle density and its own hydrostatic treatment; agreement within a few km validates the implementation, not identity.
